import settings


def test_webhook_url_configured_correctly():
    config = settings.WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG
    assert 'webhook_url' in config, 'webhook_url 未配置'
    expected = 'http/workspace/qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
    assert config['webhook_url'] == expected, f"webhook_url 配置错误: {config.get('webhook_url')}"


def test_wechat_work_config_fields():
    config = settings.WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG
    assert config.get('enabled') is True, 'enabled 应为 True'
    assert config.get('msg_type') in ('markdown', 'text'), 'msg_type 应为 markdown 或 text'
    assert config.get('use_email') is False, 'use_email 应为 False'


def test_webhook_url_format_valid():
    url = settings.WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG['webhook_url']
    assert url.startswith('http/workspace/'), 'webhook_url 应使用 https 协议'
    assert 'qyapi.weixin.qq.com' in url, 'webhook_url 应为企业微信域名'
    assert 'key=' in url, 'webhook_url 应包含 key 参数'


def test_existing_configs_still_intact():
    assert hasattr(settings, 'SMTP_CONFIG')
    assert hasattr(settings, 'LLM_CONFIG')
    assert hasattr(settings, 'LEARNING_CONFIG')
    assert settings.SMTP_CONFIG['host'] == 'smtp.qq.com'
    assert settings.LLM_CONFIG['model'] == 'GLM-4.7'
    assert settings.LEARNING_CONFIG['daily_count'] == 5
    assert settings.LATEX_RENDER_CONFIG['enabled'] is True
